description: A rule strategy over SPY, BTC and ETH against stable.

version.description: Bumped whenever the behavior changes; pinned by the lock file.

description.description: What the strategy does, in a sentence or two.

warmup_days.description: Days of history replayed before the first decision.

dma.description: The 200-day moving-average signal of each asset.

feature.description: Moving average that prices are compared with.

cross_cooldown_days.description: Days after a cross during which the opposite cross of the same asset is ignored.

cross_on_touch.description: Count a price that touches its DMA as a cross.

ratio.description: The ETH/BTC ratio against its own 200-day moving average.

cross_cooldown_days.description: Days after a ratio rotation during which the next cross is ignored.

signals.description: How the signals the rules read are built.

rules.description: Rules in precedence order: the first one that matches and is off cooldown decides the day.

oneOf.description: Sells an asset to stable when its price crosses below its 200-day DMA.

id.description: Name of the rule in decision traces.

cooldown_days.description: Days the rule stays off after it trades.

peer_groups.description: Assets that leave together when one of them crosses down. An asset in no group leaves alone.

proceeds.description: Where the cash from the exits goes.

to.description: Assets that receive a share of the proceeds, in order.

asset.description: Asset that receives part of the proceeds.

share.description: Fraction of the proceeds that goes to the asset.

cooldown_scope.description: What the cooldown is kept for. `rule`: one cooldown for the whole rule, so after any exit another asset's cross down is skipped until it ends. `trigger_symbol`: one per asset that crossed, so an exit never waits for another asset's.

oneOf.description: Moves the portfolio into the assets above their DMA when one of them crosses up.

id.description: Name of the rule in decision traces.

cooldown_days.description: Days an asset that triggered the rule cannot trigger it again.

allocation.description: `equal_weight` re-weights the whole portfolio equally across the assets above their DMA, which undoes earlier trims and rotations. `deploy_stable` keeps every holding and splits only the stable equally across those assets.

oneOf.description: Rotates between BTC and ETH when the ETH/BTC ratio crosses its 200-day DMA.

id.description: Name of the rule in decision traces.

cooldown_days.description: Days the rule stays off after it trades.

cross_up.description: Move when the ratio crosses above its DMA (ETH is the stronger leg).

cross_down.description: Move when the ratio crosses below its DMA.

oneOf.description: Moves part of BTC or ETH into the other when the ratio is far from its DMA.

id.description: Name of the rule in decision traces.

tiers.description: Distance bands, strongest first. A stronger move is not blocked by the cooldown of a milder one.

name.description: Tier name; it appears in the trade's name.

threshold.description: The tier applies from this distance from the ratio's DMA outwards.

rotation_fraction.description: Share of the source leg that moves.

cooldown_days.description: Days this tier stays off after it trades.

below.description: Move when the ratio is far below its DMA; null turns it off.

above.description: Move when the ratio is far above its DMA; null turns it off.

oneOf.description: Sells a slice of an asset that has run far above its DMA.

id.description: Name of the rule in decision traces.

cooldown_days.description: Days the rule stays off after it trades.

sell_step.description: Share sold per matching asset: of the portfolio under absolute sizing, of the asset's own position under relative sizing.

sizing.description: How `sell_step` is read: of the portfolio, or of the position.

oneOf.description: A sale is a share of the portfolio. This is how every sale read before sizing existed.
A sale is a share of the asset's own position, and it never cuts into a core.

floor_weight.description: Share of the portfolio the asset is never sold below.

thresholds.description: How far above its DMA an asset may run before it is sold into.

fgi_multipliers.description: Multiplies the thresholds by the asset's fear/greed regime. Below 1 the sale starts earlier.

extreme_fear.description: Multiplier while the regime is extreme fear.

fear.description: Multiplier while the regime is fear.

neutral.description: Multiplier while the regime is neutral.

greed.description: Multiplier while the regime is greed.

extreme_greed.description: Multiplier while the regime is extreme greed.

proceeds.description: Where the cash from the sales goes.

to.description: Assets that receive a share of the proceeds, in order.

asset.description: Asset that receives part of the proceeds.

share.description: Fraction of the proceeds that goes to the asset.

oneOf.description: Sells a slice of an asset when its fear/greed regime cools off.

rsi_at_most.description: RSI(14) level at or below which the asset counts as oversold.

long_momentum_above.description: 90-day price change must be above this (a fraction).

oneOf.description: Annualized 20-day realized volatility is at or above the asset's level.

guards.description: Limits applied after a rule has decided.

items.description: Holds the portfolio instead of trading when a trade-frequency limit is hit.

min_trade_interval_days.description: Least days between two trades; null for no limit.

max_trades_7d.description: Most trades in any 7 days; null for no limit.

max_trades_30d.description: Most trades in any 30 days; null for no limit.

overlays.description: Adjustments applied to the decision after the rules and guards.

mode.description: `block_adds` stops any rule from adding to an asset that counts as below its DMA. `force_exit` also sells what is held of it.

below_dma_buffer.description: How far under its DMA, as a fraction of the DMA, an asset must close to count as below.

confirm_days.description: Days in a row an asset must close below that distance before the guard acts.
